Retrieve the Sustainable Investment Project Portfolio

Source: R/datasets.R
senace_cartera_proyectos.Rd

Downloads the SENACE project portfolio or retrieves its bundled local snapshot.

Usage

senace_cartera_proyectos(api_key = NULL, offline = FALSE)

Arguments

api_key

A SENACE API key. If NULL, it is retrieved automatically.

offline

If TRUE, use the dataset bundled with the package instead of querying the API.

Value

A tibble.

Examples

senace_cartera_proyectos(offline = TRUE)
